scope: Verify live cross-repository propagation of the human-dignity decision boundary from Mapa through RafGitTools to ChipQuantum without making a human-value decision or deployment claim.
known_benefits: prevents computational or geometric model output from being promoted to human-value authority
preserves explicit child, privacy, dignity, review, appeal and rollback boundaries across repositories
known_harms: governance checks add review and maintenance overhead
a structural PASS could be misunderstood as ethical or legal certification if the boundary text is ignored
distribution_of_benefit_and_harm: The immediate benefit is repository-level governance consistency; the immediate burden is borne by maintainers through additional gates. No direct end-user deployment is asserted by this case.
privacy_data_surface: No personal data is required or intentionally processed by this cross-repository readback case.
child_impact: No child-specific deployment is performed. Child best-interest remains a hard constraint and specialist review remains TOKEN_VAZIO when applicable.
health_impact: No clinical or health recommendation is produced. Clinical/domain review remains TOKEN_VAZIO when applicable.
education_impact: No educational placement or learner decision is produced. Domain review remains TOKEN_VAZIO when applicable.
culture_and_belief_impact: The consumer boundary explicitly forbids treating cultural symbolism as empirical proof or human classification authority.
environmental_impact: No material environmental measurement is established by this bounded repository readback; material externality review remains TOKEN_VAZIO when applicable.
consequence_radius: repository governance and research-artifact interpretation only; no direct production decision about an individual is authorized
reversibility_or_mitigation: Changes remain version-controlled and PR-scoped; rollback is available by reverting the relevant commits. External deployment remains blocked by separate gates.
appeal_path: Repository issue/PR review and human governance review; independent appeal authority remains TOKEN_VAZIO until actually established for a deployment context.
falsifier: Fail if any exact revision is unreadable, if Mapa permits autonomous human-value authority or claim self-promotion, if the local contract loses its required invariants, or if ChipQuantum lacks the declared human-dignity/rights/child/unknown-risk boundaries.
